domains.name: Market Data Adapters
domains.purpose: Boundary translation from provider-native feeds into canonical ingress events.

domains.name: Canonical Market/Event Stream
domains.purpose: Normalize timestamp, identity, sequence, units and provider provenance.

domains.name: Raw / Historical Data Ownership
domains.purpose: Immutable/versioned raw evidence and historical retrieval/replay inputs.

domains.name: Data Quality & Provenance
domains.purpose: Freshness, completeness, duplicates, sequence, outliers, cross-provider checks, confidence and quarantine.

domains.name: Feature / Evidence Foundation
domains.purpose: Versioned derived features/evidence inputs created only from quality-qualified data.

domains.name: Market Intelligence
domains.purpose: Technical, macro, news, order-flow, market-memory and narrative evidence.

domains.name: Quant / Strategy Research
domains.purpose: Models, strategies, backtests, empirical calibration inputs and candidate decision evidence.

domains.name: Signal / Probability / Explainability
domains.purpose: Fuse independent evidence into LONG/SHORT/WAIT/NO_TRADE candidate decisions with calibrated probability and structured reasons.

domains.name: Portfolio / Risk Engine
domains.purpose: Sizing, exposure, leverage, drawdown, counterparty, portfolio state and independent veto.
forbidden: raising own ceilings without governed policy change

domains.name: Pre-Trade Firewall
domains.purpose: Deterministic final safety check immediately before executable intent.

domains.name: Execution / OMS / Reconciliation
domains.purpose: Translate approved intents to provider commands; own order lifecycle, idempotency, fills, positions and reconciliation.

domains.name: Learning / Experimentation / Model Registry
domains.purpose: Demo learning, experiments, retraining, challenger/champion evidence and drift.

domains.name: Security / Identity / Secrets Policy
domains.purpose: Identity, RBAC/MFA, secret handles, credential policy, security events and access enforcement.
forbidden: exposing raw secrets to ordinary domain modules

domains.name: Operations / Observability / Recovery
domains.purpose: Metrics, traces, health, incidents, SLOs, backup/restore, safe-mode and recovery coordination.

domains.name: Agent Control Plane
domains.purpose: Bounded A0-A10/specialist routing, handoffs, tool scopes, task context and agent health.

domains.name: Evidence / Audit Ledger
domains.purpose: Append-only evidence references, decision traceability, closure evidence and audit views.
reads: material events/evidence references from all domains

domains.name: Application API / Persian UX / Notifications
domains.future_owner: P23 UX/Application ownership to be finalized
domains.purpose: User-facing application boundary, Persian/RTL presentation, commands, explanations, team collaboration and notifications.

feedback_flows: D12_EXECUTION_OMS emits execution/position events consumed by D10_PORTFOLIO_RISK
D15_OPERATIONS_OBSERVABILITY publishes health consumed by D10/D11/D12
D13_LEARNING_EXPERIMENTATION consumes historical/replay/audit evidence but only emits promotion proposals
D17_AUDIT_EVIDENCE receives evidence from all material domains without command authority
forbidden_couplings: D12 -> override D10 or D11 verdict
D16 -> direct broker/provider credential use outside authorized domain API
operations health control -> silent risk-policy mutation
LLM narrative -> calibrated probability without empirical calibration

physical_extraction_candidates.reason: continuous streaming, reconnect/backpressure and provider-failure isolation
credential boundary, deterministic lifecycle, crash/reconciliation isolation
LLM/tool attack surface and independent permissions
external/user-facing attack surface and independent deployability
must preserve veto authority; process isolation decision belongs to P02-E/G
research/CPU workloads can scale independently without forcing microservice decomposition

rules: Cross-domain writes use explicit command/event contracts.
Direct shared-table ownership across domains is forbidden unless P02-C explicitly defines a shared reference read model.
Only the owning domain mutates its authoritative state.
Read models may be replicated; ownership does not transfer.
Provider-specific extension metadata may be preserved but cannot become core identity.
Every material command/event carries trace/audit correlation identifiers.
